brief:
Qatar has categorically rejected accusations by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at the UN General Assembly that Doha is running a campaign to "brainwash young people" into hating Israel and the West, Middle East Eye reported.

Netanyahu made the allegations during his address to the General Assembly, but Qatar's government dismissed the claims outright without providing further details on the nature of the disputed campaign.
dek: Qatar rejects Netanyahu’s claims over anti-Israel campaign Qatar categorically rejects claims by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu at the UN General Assembly that Doha is running a campaign to “brainwash young people” into hating Israel and the West.
title: Qatar denies Netanyahu's claims of anti-Israel campaign
